summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title), returning True when the control is written on a terminal and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title with the control's second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing was run: tests and Black were not executed, per instructions. No commit was made.
